newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: India sells Madras naphtha to Glencore at -$19/T.
newsitem.headline: India sells Madras naphtha to Glencore at -$19/T.

text.p: State-owned Indian Oil Corp (IOC) has sold by tender 27,000 tonnes of low aromatic naphtha (LAN) lifting April 21-25 to Swiss trader Glencore at $19.00 per tonne below Japanese spot quotes, free-on-board Madras on the east coast, industry sources said on Tuesday.
The tender closed on April 10 and was valid for one day.

IOC's last LAN tender from the east coast, lifting Vizag during mid-April, was awarded at $25 per tonne below Japanese spot quotes on an fob basis, while its last Madras LAN cargo, lifting January 27-29, was awarded at a $23-to-$24 discount.
